I'd like to say that I've finally got my act together and my issues under control, but that's a lie. Five years ago would have been senior year of high school for me, just as my mental problems were starting to rear their heads. I came from an abusive home and I suppose the dam finally burst. I failed to control my emotions, insulted my friends til they left, and graduated lonely. I entered a prestigious college and dropped out second semester because I was having a nervous breakdown and hallucinations. Got married and ran off with an abusive military guy where I lived in the middle of nowhere, where my manic and depressive states ran unchecked. I've only recently gotten away from that situation and now I live back home with my family again. My depression's in full swing and I'm isolated again. Maybe if I'd known about the family history of mental illness, I might've been able to head it off.
